paragraphs: Rabbi Abba, son of Rabbi Pappi, and Rabbi Yehoshua of Sikhnin, in Rabbi Levi’s name (Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 4, mishnah 1; Bikkurim, beginning of chapter 2; Ve'ellu Megallechin, halakhah 5; and Rabbah, Metzora, chapter 18; see below, Avimi b.P.). He asked Rabbi Yose (Niddah, chapter 2). Rabbi Mana said, “I raised this difficulty before Rabbi Ba, son of Rabbi Pappi” (Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Kirah, halakhah 1).
